aiMetadata.description: Adds a subscriber to a Buttondown newsletter by email address, with optional tags, metadata, UTM attribution, and referral data. Not idempotent: each call creates a subscriber; control duplicate-email handling via collision behavior (default keeps the existing subscriber, or overwrite/merge tags).

tags.description: Filter by subscribers who have at least one of these tags.

emailAddress.description: Return subscribers whose email address contains this value.

aiMetadata.description: Lists subscribers from a Buttondown newsletter, optionally filtered by type, source, tags, email substring, or referrer URL; with no filters it returns all subscribers. Use to look up or enumerate subscribers. Read-only and idempotent. Returns one page (default 100); pass the returned cursor to page through results.

triggerBilling.description: Enable when this email should count against pay-per-email billing for paid subscribers.

aiMetadata.description: Creates an email in Buttondown from a subject and Markdown/HTML body, then handles it per the chosen delivery status (e.g. send now vs. schedule for a future publish date, or save as draft). Use to broadcast a newsletter or queue one for later. A publish date is required when status is scheduled. Not idempotent: each call creates and may dispatch a new email.

de.IDs of attachments uploaded via the Butt: IDs von Anhängen, die über die Buttondown-API hochgeladen werden.
de.Enable when this email should count agai: Aktivieren, wenn diese E-Mail gegen Pay-per-E-Mail-Abrechnung für bezahlte Abonnenten gezählt werden soll.
